title: Exploring Large Language Models for Effective Rumor Detection on Social Media

live_model.evidence: "LLMs were tested: gpt-4o-2024-05-13, GPT-3.5-turbo-0125...SePro with gpt-4o-2024-05-13 achieved...an accuracy of 96.7%." (Sec Limitation, Fig. 11).

prompt.location: Appendix: "Prompt 1: Chain of Clues", "Prompt 2: System Prompt", Table 4 (input system-prompt template)
prompt.note: Zero-shot baselines with the same LLMs are also reported (line ~867-868).

claim.metric: accuracy, SePro framework with gpt-4o-2024-05-13 backbone

data.source: Twitter15+16 (Ma et al. 2017) and Weibo (Ma et al. 2018b) rumor-detection benchmarks (public)

notes: gpt-4o-2024-05-13 is also tested zero-shot (no SePro graph augmentation) as a baseline in the same figure, giving a second, framework-independent claim if a cleaner isolated-model number is wanted. Soft note: the exact number of test instances behind the 96.7% figure is not stated in the excerpted text, though Twitter15/16 and Weibo are standard, well-documented public splits.
